learning_outcomes.text: Obtain particular knowledge of the structure of substances, chemical phenomena and processes, directly connected with engineering.
Simulate chemical processes and show the way for their use or avoidance in engineering practice.
Achieve leveling of students	 previous knowledge of chemistry.
Provide necessary knowledge and skills for the next courses of Physics, Materials and Manufacturing Engineering, Strength of Materials, etc.

syllabus_topics: Review and classification of the main groups of organic compounds used in engineering practice.
Isomerism of the organic compounds and its influence on their properties.

assessment_methods.method: Test control on basic topics (written or oral, approx. 15 minutes)

degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
